Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Aparesh Kumar Singh Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Kailash
Prasad Deo

For the Appellant : None For the Respondent : Mr.Kanti Kumar Ojha (for Resp. no.4)
: A.C. to A.G. 09/19.09.2019
No one appears for the appellant.
Learned counsel for the respondent State and the private respondent are present.
Earlier the matter has been adjourned at the instance of learned counsel for the appellant.

As such,
we do feel inclined to adjourn the matter further.
It is accordingly dismissed for non-prosecution.
